customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be worth the money and appreciate its performance, installation, and taste. The water quality receives positive feedback, with the app clearly showing water quality and filter status, and one customer noting TDS levels below 100. Customers like the appearance, with one highlighting the modern touch panel with LED indicators, and they value the 2-year hassle-free service. However, reliability is a concern, with multiple customers reporting that their units stopped working within one month.

reviews.author: Madhan
reviews.title: Not superb for this price, water taste is good for me
reviews.body: I like the product and water also tastes good. Still few issues are there on build and software. 1. Tray build is not good which is already broken for me in a month 2. Software bugs, if you are in offline water consumption level is not tracking. 3. Same as everyone touch is not working. Might need a larger touch sensitivity area so that it can register easily These issues can be adjustable, but overall it's a good purifier as of now 😂

reviews.title: Excellent Product & Hassle-Free Experience – Highly Recommended!
reviews.body: Really happy with my experience with the Urban Company Native M2 Pro. The product looks premium, works smoothly, and the performance has been excellent so far. Great product for the price, and I’m satisfied with my purchase. Highly recommended! 👍
